subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw add a public native subagent completion-routing contract named `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"`, and should it exist both per-spawn and as `agents.defaults.subagents.announceTarget`?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public model-facing tool and config/default semantics that determine whether completions wake the parent session or reach the external channel.

options.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
options.body: Add `announceTarget` to both `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session without direct channel delivery.

options.title: Approve per-spawn only
options.body: Add only an explicit per-call override first to reduce global config surface while enabling orchestrator-controlled handoffs.

options.title: Defer native routing
options.body: Keep current requester handoff behavior and direct users to existing callbacks or a broader structured handoff design before adding a public routing knob.

recommendation.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
recommendation.body: Add `announceTarget` to both `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session without direct channel delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across `sessions_spawn`, announce delivery, config defaults, and the prior ownership-routing fix.
